title: Chapter 30 The Moment Of Life And Death
content:
Chapter 30 The Moment Of Life And Death

At the same time, in the Hongmeng Universe.

Countless powerful galaxies suddenly broke through the border barrier and headed in one direction.

This news instantly attracted the attention of the border defense line at the edge of the universe.

"My Hongmeng Universe is indeed a united universe."

The eyes of the old man in the lead were red, and he was so excited that he shed tears.

Many powerful people around him also nodded in agreement.

"The universe is in trouble. As a person in the Hongmeng Universe, how can I stand idly by."

At this time, a middle-aged man was puzzled and said: "But speaking of it, we haven't notified them yet. Who told them this news?"

Hearing this, everyone was stunned.

It seems so.

At this time, the old man in the lead snorted coldly and said: "There must be a capable person among them."

"Thinking of my Hongmeng Universe, it is natural that there are many capable people."

Hearing this, everyone did not dare to refute, and nodded in response.

Because Old Yang is the oldest, most powerful, and the oldest senior here.

"Old Yang is right."

"Old Yang, should we wait for them to come together before we start?"

Hearing this, the old man called Old Yang pondered for a moment and nodded.

"Of course we have to wait."

This border defense line was jointly established by these strong men.

The purpose of establishing this is to resist foreign races.

A long, long, long time ago, it can almost be traced back to the ancient times.

The evil demons invaded the Hongmeng Universe on a large scale.

The entire Hongmeng Universe was in a life-and-death situation.

In the end, countless strong men put aside their past grudges, stood up one after another, and joined forces to force the evil demons back.

In that battle, the Hongmeng Universe was severely damaged.

Countless powerful men died tragically.

In that era, the Hongmeng Universe was in its heyday.

The unknown realms were almost as numerous as dogs, and the cause and effect realms were everywhere, unlike now.

And the one who sacrificed the most was the strongest galaxy at that time, the Xuan Gu Galaxy.

At that time, there were even eight beings above the realm of life and death in the Xuan Gu Galaxy, known as the Eight Kings, which could be said to be invincible in the entire Hongmeng Universe. (Unknown Realm, Causal Realm, Life and Death Realm, Reincarnation Realm)

In that battle, the eight strong men rushed to the front, and in the end, the evil demons were repelled, but they never came back.

It was from that time that the Xuan Gu Galaxy completely declined.

From the strongest galaxy, it gradually declined to a fourth-level galaxy, and completely faded out of the eyes of the world.

Of course, these things are now almost unknown to anyone.

Even the evil demon clan, most people in the universe don’t know.

And they are the existences above the unknown realm strong men in the major galaxies.

They were once the absolute kings of their respective galaxies.

Once they broke through to the unknown realm, they would send people to take them over and fight against the evil demon clan together.

Don’t look at the constant wars between the major galaxies.

But in fact, the power between their top is very united.

Once a huge war breaks out in the major galaxies, they will secretly take action to resolve it.

And now, the abyss is obviously unable to stop them.

The Hongmeng Universe must unite again.

"Duan Laodi, when will the girl you mentioned break through to the causal realm?"

At this time, an old man came to Duan Heng and asked.

Duan Heng, the strongest person in the Eternal Galaxy and the former master of the Eternal Temple.

He broke through the causal realm 40 million years ago and was brought to the border of this universe.

Hearing this, Duan Heng hesitated and said, "Maybe, it will take some time. After all, the universe today is far less prosperous than before."

Hearing this, the old man sighed.

"We don't have much time now."

Indeed, they all know that this abyss can't hold them for long.

Once the abyss collapses, their last line of defense will be the border they built.

Although they have engraved countless formations on it, even ancient formations, it is actually not as stable as the abyss.

Therefore, the only one they can really rely on is themselves.

The more strength they can have, the more strength they can have.

After a moment of silence, Duan Heng bowed and said, "In this case, I will go back and take a look. If possible, I want to bring her here directly. Maybe here, she can break through faster."

Hearing this, the old man nodded.

The others also said, "Then you should be careful."

Duan Heng smiled, "Isn't this the most dangerous place in the entire universe?"

Suddenly, the others also laughed.

Then, Duan Heng clasped his fists and left directly.

"Okay, don't look at it, continue to suppress it."

Everyone shook their heads, and then continued to urge the huge power in their bodies to go towards the endless abyss.

.........

I don't know how long it took.

At the boundary barrier of the Xuan Gu Galaxy.

Boom!

Countless cracks spread, and the next moment, several huge holes appeared on the barrier.

Then, countless forces rushed into the Xuan Gu Galaxy.

Suddenly, the entire Xuan Gu Galaxy began to tremble.

These are the powerful forces from the major galaxies of the Hongmeng Universe.

That's right, their goal is the treasure in the deserted city of the Xuan Gu Galaxy, not to support the border of the universe and fight against the evil demons.

"Is this the Xuan Gu Galaxy? It is indeed a low-level galaxy."

"Haha, I don't care what galaxy it is, I'm just here to look for treasure."

"Treasures will naturally go to the capable."

Suddenly, all the forces no longer hesitated and headed towards the direction of the Tianxuan World.

It is hard to imagine that the strongest forces of the major galaxies would gather together today.

Some of them are sects, some are families, and some are holy places. Each of them is at the top of their own galaxy.

Among them, most are second-level galaxies.

There are very few first-level galaxies.

As for third-level galaxies, there is none.

Because it is difficult for a third-level galaxy to break through the galaxy barrier, and the resources consumed by crossing the void are extremely terrifying, so only galaxies above the third-level galaxy can afford it.

......

In the deserted city of Tianxuan World.

"Are you here?"

Lu Daosheng looked up at the void again.

This time, his eyes were full of coldness.

Because among the forces that came, there were also the two major forces of Xieyun Sect and Tianjian Sect from last time.

In fact, if these two forces had not come, Lu Daosheng was ready to not pursue the matter.

Unfortunately, they did not seize this only chance to survive.

"Come here!"

The next moment, all the strong men in the City Lord's Mansion appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

"Lord City Lord."

Lu Daosheng looked at everyone.

There was A Wei, Huang Shou, An Xing, Yun Qi, etc.

"This time, let them see the strength of my Huangcheng."

"Yes! Lord City Lord."

Suddenly, the whole Huangcheng sounded with exciting bells.

Everyone looked up at the void.

Suddenly, they saw countless powerful auras covering the entire Huangcheng like a dark cloud.

Everyone was panicked.

At this time, in the City Lord's Mansion.

Lu Daosheng clenched his palm.

An indestructible passport directly enveloped the entire Tianxuan world.

That's right, it was the entire Tianxuan world.

Last time, he was careless, causing damage to some parts of the Tianxuan world outside the deserted city.

This matter was his responsibility.

So this time, he directly protected the entire world by himself.

Above the Tianxuan world.

In the starry sky.

Countless forces were staring at the deserted city like wolves and tigers.

They were a little unbelievable at this moment. There were so many treasures in such a place.

However, it was impossible for all these forces to be stupid.

Some forces were definitely wrong, and then quietly retreated.

Once something was wrong, they would run away.

And a smaller part of the forces ran away directly.

As for the rest, they had already been dazzled by the treasures in front of them.

"As long as we take over this world, these treasures will all be ours, charge!"

"Charge!"

Suddenly, countless forces rushed up directly.

Boom!

Countless loud noises sounded from the shield.

However, the entire shield did not move at all.

Suddenly, all the forces were stunned on the spot.

Is it so tough?

Among the forces behind, Xieyun Sect and Tianjian Sect were watching coldly from behind.

They knew that the strength of that city was not simple.

So they learned their lesson this time and waited until they were almost done fighting before taking action.

"Hey, listen to me, you bastards inside, open this thing immediately, otherwise,..."

"Otherwise, when we go in, I will slaughter your entire world."

An ancient realm strongman stared at the deserted city below fiercely.

"Really?"

At this moment, a sword sounded.

The next moment, the arrogant ancient realm strongman was stunned on the spot.

And his head slowly slid down.

One sword to split the body!

All the forces around were immediately horrified.

Kill an ancient realm strongman with one sword? !

At this time, Huang Shou appeared in the starry sky.

Not only the Huangshou, but also countless forces in Huangcheng, including Huangwei, Lujiajun, and Nangong Family.

It is worth mentioning that the Nangong Family was commended in the last war.

Almost half of the Nangong Family was qualified to enter the inner city.

This immediately aroused the envy of countless people in the outer city.

So this time, countless strong men in the outer city stood up and fought side by side with Huangcheng.
